name: zoomies-readiness
description: GitHub Action that assesses workflow readiness for Zoomies self-hosted runners

scripts.format: prettier --write action.yml package.json src test .github README.md CONTRIBUTING.md SECURITY.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check action.yml package.json src test .github README.md CONTRIBUTING.md SECURITY.md
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm test && npm run build
